news.title: Georgia woman arrested after kittens thrown from vehicle, police say
news.summary: Valentina Tobon Henao, 25, was arrested after allegedly throwing multiple kittens out of a vehicle in Brookhaven.

news.title: Fallen soldier, 25-year-old Georgia soldier Tyler Feehan, buried in Canton
news.summary: Army 1st Lt. Tyler Feehan, a Georgia soldier killed in action, will be buried with military honors in Canton on Friday.

news.title: VIDEO: Suspect accused of stealing golf cart near Beltline caught after foot chase
news.summary: A reported golf cart theft near the Atlanta Beltline ended with a foot chase and an arrest, according to police.

news.title: DeKalb fallen officer David Rose being remembered 1 year later
news.summary: DeKalb County police Officer David Rose was killed Aug. 8, 2025, while responding to an active shooter outside the CDC.

news.title: Chastain Park plans $13.5M expansion with new nature trail
news.summary: The Chastain Park Conservancy is preparing for a major expansion after years of community feedback showed visitors wanted more places to relax and enjoy nature.

news.title: DeKalb County police car involved in early morning crash
news.summary: A DeKalb County police vehicle was involved in an early morning crash Friday.

news.title: Former metro Atlanta high school track coach accused of stealing about $65K from booster club
news.summary: Matthew Henson, a Hall of Fame coach with Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, was charged with theft by taking.

news.title: Sandy Springs Police ask for public's help identifying aggravated assault suspect
news.summary: The suspect, who is described as a Latino man, is wanted in connection with an aggravated assault that happened on June 27 in the Northwood Drive area.

news.title: Dallas ISD police officer recovering after Dallas Sam's Club shooting, officials say
news.summary: A Dallas ISD officer, 39-year-old Justin Jones, was shot at a Sam's Club by a man he had stopped to help, police say. Jones has been with the department for 16 years

news.title: Former Douglasville high school teacher waives bond hearing, will remain jailed as 27-count sex crimes case heads toward trial
news.summary: She waived the hearing, meaning she will not seek bond at this stage of the case and will remain in the Douglas County Jail pending further court proceedings.
